'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Wayne Cullen LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Wayne Cullen]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Username:''' KissmyWookiee
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
